summary: Retested the iteration_1 fixes through 17 public-URL pytest cases and Playwright end-to-end flows. Product colour/sold-out admin controls and persistence, public sold-out rendering, settings hydration, email-scoped lockout, review approve/hide semantics, seeded reviews, review submission, colour ordering/WhatsApp text, and admin order status persistence pass. Review-upload magic-byte validation remains broken: spoofed image/png bytes are accepted with 201.

critical.issue: Arbitrary non-image bytes sent as image/png are still accepted, stored, and returned with 201 instead of 400 'Invalid image file'.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening the Add/Edit Product dialog logs Radix's accessibility warning because DialogContent has no DialogDescription or explicit aria-describedby={undefined}.

action_items: In upload_review_photo, call is_valid_image(data) after reading/size validation and before put_object; return HTTP 400 with detail 'Invalid image file' when validation fails.
Add DialogDescription to the product form dialog, or explicitly disable aria-describedby, to remove the accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: The review upload handler reads bytes and immediately calls put_object without the is_valid_image(data) check already used by the authenticated /api/upload handler; this is the direct root cause of the failed security regression.
put_object, get_object, and init_storage use synchronous requests inside async FastAPI handlers/startup, which can block the event loop during storage latency.
AdminDashboard.js is 702 lines and should be split into focused product, order, review, and settings components.
WhatsApp destination URLs remain hardcoded in App.js and ProductDetail.js, and the backend has a hardcoded WHATSAPP_NUMBER fallback, contrary to the environment-only configuration requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested functional flows passed; 1 minor accessibility warning

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ reviews, orders, product/settings mutations, lockout records, and upload records. MongoDB test data was removed; settings/product state was restored, all products are available, and the three seeded reviews remain approved. Storage objects created by upload tests may remain orphaned externally because the app exposes no object-delete operation, but their DB records were removed so they are not publicly retrievable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run backend_test.py after adding review-upload byte validation. All requested fixes except spoofed review image rejection passed. CORS was intentionally not retested per the handoff. Current database verification found no TEST_ orders/reviews/products/login attempts/files, exactly three approved seeded reviews, zero sold-out products, and original blank settings restored.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: multipart POST arbitrary bytes with filename ending .png and Content-Type image/png to /api/reviews/upload; response is 201. In server.py, upload_review_photo validates MIME and size only, then calls put_object. The is_valid_image helper is invoked by /api/upload but omitted from /api/reviews/upload. Add the same pre-storage signature/decoder validation there.
